notes.title: Mini-boss update!
notes.content:
To add some more variety to each run, there are now five different mini-bosses that can show up as you attempt to survive the night. 

Each mini-boss has its own unique attack patterns you'll have to contend with, from a cheering crowd that calls down weights of expectation, to a megaphone-headed office manager that assaults you with demands to work harder.

In addition to the mini-bosses, random events will now occur throughout each run, forcing you to adapt to new enemies and hazards.

Coupled with the recent introduction of Mosh Pit mode, this update should provide a fresh challenge to players who've already mastered the core gameplay loop.

I hope you enjoy this update, and please let me know if you have any feedback!
